chunks: Rawh narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Nine-tenths of sustenance is in trade.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, the Imam from whom the hadith is narrated
key_terms.التِّجَارَةِ: trade or commerce as a means of livelihood
key_terms.الرِّزْقِ: sustenance or provision granted to a person
key_terms.رَوْحٌ: Rawh, the narrator transmitting the hadith

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say about sustenance being found in trade?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights trade as a major means through which sustenance is obtained. It emphasizes the importance of commerce as a significant avenue of livelihood in human society.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3858 - Rawh narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said: "
Nine-tenths of sustenance is in trade."
